source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-7

procedures.title: Three-speed floor shift linkage adjustment (Corvette)
parts: shift control lever and bracket assembly
steps: Loosen the swivel lock nuts on both shift rods; each rod must slide freely through its swivel.
Put the shift lever inside the car in neutral and insert a 41/64 in. locating gauge in the notch of the lever and bracket assembly.
By hand, move the shift levers on the transmission to neutral.
With the 1st/reverse rod and lever held against the gauge, tighten the locknut against the swivel.
With the 2nd/3rd rod and lever held against the gauge, run the front nut up to the swivel, then tighten the rear nut against the swivel.
Pull the gauge and check the shifts.
Go back to neutral and reinsert the gauge; if it will not slide freely into the bracket assembly, adjust the linkage again.
notes: See figure 7 in the manual (Corvette linkage at the side cover and gauge location).

procedures.title: Three-speed shift control lever and bracket assembly: replace (Corvette)
steps: Inside the car, take off the shift lever knob.
Remove the console trim plate and the seat assembly.
Unhook the transmission control rods from the shift control levers.
Remove the bolts holding the shift control to the support bracket.
Remove the bolts holding the support bracket to the crossmember.
Take the support out of the car, then pull the control assembly downward out of the console boot and out of the car.
notes: For disassembly of the lever and bracket, use figure 9 in the manual for the parts breakdown and how they are positioned.
